description: This PHP class 'LangStringHelper' provides methods for managing language strings in a database, including retrieving group IDs, deleting non-customized strings, inserting or updating language strings from YAML files, and fetching string IDs by value or unit ID. It interacts with Doctrine DBAL for database operations and is part of the OrangeHRM installer utilities.

classes.name: LangStringHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing language strings in the database, including CRUD operations and synchronization with YAML files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the helper with a database connection.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Doctrine QueryBuilder instance.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of LanguageHelper, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a language group by its name.

methods.name: deleteNonCustomizedLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes language strings that are not marked as customized within a specific group.

methods.name: getLangStringIdsForGroup
methods.description: Fetches all language string IDs associated with a specific group.

methods.name: getNonCustomizedLangStringIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of language strings that are not customized within a group.

methods.name: insertOrUpdateLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from a YAML file and inserts or updates them in the database.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByValueAndGroup
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a language string by its value and optional group ID.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByUnitIdAndGroup
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a language string by its unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: saveLangString
methods.description: Inserts a new language string record into the database.

methods.name: updateLangString
methods.description: Updates an existing language string record in the database.

search-terms: fetch language string by unit id
